records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Sales increased in the third quarter and in the first nine months of fiscal 2024 driven by increased sales in our Beef, Pork and Prepared Foods segments, partially offset by decreased sales in our Chicken segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Sales Volume – Sales were positively impacted by an increase in sales volume, which accounted for a $142 million increase in sales driven by increased sales volume in our Beef, Pork and Prepared Foods segments, partially offset by decreased sales volume in our Chicken segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •An increase of $111 million due to a decrease in inventory of $249 million in the first nine months of fiscal 2024, compared to a decrease of $138 million in the first nine months of fiscal 2023, primarily driven by decreased average cost of inventory and lower volume of livestock.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our total operating margin was 2.6% in the third quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We recorded operating income of $341 million for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 as compared to an operating loss of $350 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2023 primarily driven by higher operating income in our Chicken segment and International/Other, partially offset by lower operating income in our Beef segment.
